findings.title: Only one active ad in a spending ad group
findings.detail: A single creative leaves the system no room to optimize and fatigues faster.
findings.recommendation: Add two to three ad variations per ad group to enable creative optimization.

findings.title: Top-quartile performer constrained by budget

findings.title: Campaign under-delivering against its budget
findings.detail: This campaign spent well below its theoretical budget across the window.
findings.recommendation: Bids may be too low or the audience too narrow. Loosen targeting or raise the bid to unlock delivery.

findings.title: Account spend concentrated in a single campaign
findings.detail: Most of the account budget sits in one campaign, which is fragile if that audience or creative fatigues.
findings.recommendation: Diversify into a second proven structure so one fatiguing campaign cannot sink the account.
